title: Rhythms and Reading - More and Most
desc: Grammar rules for comparative (more ... than) and superlative (the most).

sentences.en: Horse riding is more exciting than cycling.
sentences.ar: ركوب الخيل أكثر إثارة من ركوب الدراجة.

sentences.en: Rock climbing is more dangerous than jogging.
sentences.ar: تسلق الصخور أكثر خطورة من الجري.

sentences.en: Hang gliding is the most dangerous.
